SessionUserOut.description:
The signed-in user, as auth's token exchange reports them.

Only these four fields come from auth's exchange body; its consent and
academic fields never reach the browser.
SessionUserOut.title: SessionUserOut

description:
POST /v1/account/session 200 response (Cache-Control: no-store).

`access_token` is the short-lived JWT auth minted for audience "router" in
exchange for the caller's SSO session cookie. The router has already verified it
through the same JWKS path as /v1/keys. The SPA keeps it in memory only, sends it
as `Authorization: Bearer`, and exchanges again on a 401 or before `expires_in`
seconds have passed.
title: SessionOut
